_meta.note: Curriculum index. Full lesson content lives in data/units/<unit id>.json. Lesson types: alphabet | vocab | grammar | verb | reading.

units.title: Ὁ Λόγος
units.summary: Read the alphabet, meet the ten most common words in the New Testament, learn 'to be' and 'the', and read John 1:1–2 in Greek.

lessons.label: καί
lessons.sub: The ten most common little words

lessons.label: εἰμί
lessons.sub: To be, and the words of John 1:1

lessons.label: ὁ ἡ τό
lessons.sub: The article and the four cases

units.title: Ὁ Λόγος καὶ ὁ Θεός
units.summary: The first and second declensions, prepositions with their cases, adjectives that agree, the personal pronouns, and John 1:3–5.

lessons.label: μαθητής
lessons.sub: More nouns: -ης masculines and the odd ones

lessons.label: ἐν ἐκ εἰς
lessons.sub: Prepositions and the cases they take

units.title: Λύω
units.summary: Regular verbs in the present, deponents, contract verbs, the imperfect, the infinitive, and John 1:6–13.

lessons.label: ἔλυον
lessons.sub: The imperfect tense (and εἰμί in the past)

units.title: Πᾶς
units.summary: Consonant-stem nouns (πατήρ, πνεῦμα, πίστις, βασιλεύς), the big adjectives πᾶς, πολύς, μέγας, numbers, and John 1:14–18.

lessons.label: πίστις
lessons.sub: -ις and -ευς nouns, and more second declension

lessons.label: πᾶς πολύς
lessons.sub: πᾶς, πολύς, μέγας, εἷς and numbers

units.title: Ἔλυσα
units.summary: The future, the first and second aorist, the aorist passive, liquid verbs, and John 1:19–28. Aspect, not just time.

units.title: Λέλυκα
units.summary: The perfect and pluperfect, the subjunctive with ἵνα and ἐάν, the imperative, and John 1:29–42.

units.title: Λύων
units.summary: The verbal adjective that Greek prose runs on: present, aorist and perfect participles in every voice, their uses, the genitive absolute, and John 1:43–51.

units.title: Οἶδα
units.summary: Principal parts, the -μι verbs, the irregular-verb drill pool, conditional sentences, the optative, and 1 John 1. After this Book you know every word that occurs 50+ times in the New Testament.

lessons.label: εἶπον ἦλθον
lessons.sub: Strange verbs I: the big ten

lessons.label: ἔγνων ἔπεσον
lessons.sub: Strange verbs II: the rest of the pool
